name: Popup
access: OML creates this object from a selector:Popup node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique id. Required.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Pixels as a number, or a percent or size expression. Required.

properties.name: height
properties.description: Pixels as a number, or a percent or size expression. Required.

properties.name: min_width
properties.description: Minimum width in pixels when resizable. Optional.

properties.name: min_height
properties.description: Minimum height in pixels when resizable. Optional.

properties.name: max_width
properties.description: Maximum width in pixels when resizable. Optional.

properties.name: max_height
properties.description: Maximum height in pixels when resizable. Optional.

properties.name: x
properties.description: Start x position. Optional.

properties.name: y
properties.description: Start y position. Optional.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title. Optional.

properties.name: buttons
properties.description: Strings or objects. Optional.

properties.name: tabs
properties.description: Tab items, in the shape OGX.Tabs expects. Optional.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Path of the top-left icon. Optional.

properties.name: icons
properties.description: Icons in the top-right corner. Optional.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: The body scrolls. Optional.

properties.name: drag
properties.description: The popup can be dragged. Optional.

properties.name: resize
properties.description: The popup can be resized. Optional.

properties.name: keep_ratio
properties.description: Keep the aspect ratio while resizing. Optional.

properties.name: center
properties.description: Keep the popup centered. Optional.

properties.name: maximize
properties.description: The popup can be maximized. Optional.

properties.name: maximize_dbc
properties.description: Double-click on the head maximizes the popup. Optional.

properties.name: group
properties.description: Group name for merging popups. Optional.

properties.name: group_icon
properties.description: Default icon for the group. Optional.

properties.name: html
properties.description: HTML placed in the body. Optional.

properties.name: template
properties.description: Template name for the body. Optional.

properties.name: anim
properties.description: OGX.Popup.FADE, SCALE, or SLIDE. The strings are fade, scale, and slide. The test app uses scale. Optional.

properties.name: anim_param
properties.description: Defaults to {scale: 0.7}. Optional.

properties.name: zindex
properties.description: Z-index. Optional.

properties.name: css
properties.description: Class added to the body. Optional.

properties.name: view
properties.description: View configuration object. Optional.

properties.name: delay_oml
properties.description: Renders the OML content on the next thread. Optional.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Read as {{$}} when the OML content renders. Optional.

properties.name: swipe
properties.description: Set in the simple OML example. The main config block does not describe it. Optional.

properties.name: show
properties.description: Set in the simple OML example. The main config block does not describe it. Optional.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Sets the width, as in width(500). A call that reads the size returns the configured value, which may be the size expression. el.width() is the computed size.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Sets the height. The wiki example passes an anim flag and a callback. A read returns the configured value. el.height() is the computed size.

catalog_status: Listed fields and methods are from the OGX.JS wiki or the runtime the test app loads. Members that are absent from this file are not to be invented.
